title: VaultLoopEntry
description: A single stage record within the Vault Loop. Records chain via parent_entry_id to form the loop. VaultLoopEntry is a record TYPE that lives across the six existing vaults (Strategic / Technical / Creative / Operational / Wisdom / Horizon) under privacy classification — NOT a seventh vault. Privacy is the substrate trust contract; 'private' entries MUST NOT appear in export, search, attestation, or knowledge-graph output.

id.description: Unique identifier for this stage record.

vault.description: Which of the six existing vaults this record lives under. The VaultLoop is a record TYPE across vaults, not a seventh vault.

stage.description: The stage of the loop this record represents.

privacy.description: Substrate trust contract. 'private' entries MUST NOT appear in export, search, attestation, or knowledge-graph output. 'private-shareable' may appear in scoped exports to explicitly named recipients. 'public' may appear on any surface.

parent_entry_id.description: Identifier of the upstream entry this record extends. NULL for the root Desire.

payload.description: The content of the stage record.

created_by.description: Identifier of the agent or sovereign that recorded this stage.

stale_at.description: Computed timestamp at which this entry is considered stale if no downstream stage has been added. Conventionally created_at + 30 days. Used for soft stale-loop nudges in the dashboard; not authoritative for retention.
